== Description ==

[[Mark Billings]] (left, ponytail, glasses, colorful patterned long-sleeve), [[Randy Scott]] (center, black cap, glasses, beard, grey tee, name tag), [[Brian Fred]] (background right, bald, black tank), and [[Spencer Gosiaco]] (right, black Mariners “S” cap, plaid shirt, black hoodie) at the [[2025 World Championship]] on 4 October 2025.
